documents.title: Doc 17 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 4 practice start - end of FP
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 4 practice start - end of FP

details.fact: Car 4 failed to comply with Race Director instructions regarding the Practice Starts on the grid at the end of the Practice Session.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code - Race Director Competition notes Item 15.4 b.
details.decision: Reprimand given to the Driver of Car 4. This is his first Driving Reprimand of the 2026 Season.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 11) and heard from the driver of Car 4 (Bilinski) and the team representative, and reviewed video evidence. At the end of Free Practice, Car 4 approached the grid to carry out a practice start. The driver stated that he engaged the launch procedure before the last corner. On the approach to the grid, he saw that Car 3 (Miyata) was stationary ahead of him on the same side of the grid, with its rear light flashing. He understood this to mean that Car 3 may have been in anti-stall mode. He stated that, as he was holding both clutch paddles, he could not cancel the launch procedure, and that releasing the clutch would have launched the car. Car 4 then carried out a practice start while Car 3 was still stationary two grid positions ahead of it on the same side of the grid. The Stewards queried this with the FIA Technical Delegate and the F2 Technical Director, who confirmed that the launch procedure can be cancelled. Paragraph 15.4 b) of the Race Director's Competition Notes (Document 9) states: "Under no circumstances should a driver make a practice start if another car is still stationary ahead on the same side of the grid." Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that the driver of Car 4 failed to follow that instruction and is in breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code, and he is penalised accordingly.

documents.title: Doc 15 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 17 - yellow flag infringement in Practice
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 17 - yellow flag infringement in Practice

details.fact: Car 17 (Inthraphuvasak) failed to respect the yellow flag requirements at Turn 11 in Practice, shown because Car 21 had left the track.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 (b) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: A drop of five (5) places on the grid for the Sprint Race & Feature Race at this Competition. In addition, 2 points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 4 points.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 12) and heard the Driver of Car 17 (Inthraphuvasak) and the team representative, in the presence of the FIA F2 Technical Delegate, and reviewed video, GPS, telemetry and marshalling sector times. The driver stated that he heard the yellow flag warning beep in Turn 10 and believed that he had reduced speed in that corner. The Stewards did not accept this argument, as the reduction in speed occurred before the yellow flag was displayed. Moreover, the telemetry data of Car 17, provided by the Technical Delegate, did not show any reduction in speed or any reaction from the driver to the yellow flag at Turn 11 between MP13 and MP14. Article 2.5.5 b) of Appendix H of the FIA International Sporting Code requires that, under a single waved yellow flag, it must be evident that a driver has reduced speed. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that the driver did not reduce speed in the yellow flag sector and is in breach. Accordingly, the standard penalty for failing to slow for single yellow flags during Free Practice is applied: a drop of five grid positions and two penalty points. In accordance with Article 31.5 of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations, the grid penalty applies to both the Sprint Race and the Feature Race.
